start.title: Die Stimme von oben
start.text:
Gott spricht zu dir.
„Baue dir eine Arche. Eine Flut wird kommen.“

choices.text: [TODO:de] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: Eine zuschauende Welt
mockery.text:
Die Welt um dich herum ist verdorben und gewalttätig.
Sie beobachten dich beim Bau. Wie reagierst du?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Zypressenholz und Pech
building.text:
Du sammelst die Materialien, die Gott befohlen hat.
Wie baust du die Arche?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: Sie steht vollendet da
ark_done.text:
Die Arche ist fertig, genau wie Gott es befohlen hat.
Wie sieht sie aus?

choices.text: [TODO:de] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:de] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:de] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: Die Kreaturen kommen
animals.text:
Die Tiere kommen zur Arche.
Wen nimmst du an Bord?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: Die Tür geschlossen
boarding.text:
Es ist Zeit, die Arche zu betreten.
Wer betritt sie, und wer schließt die Tür?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: Vierzig Tage Regen
storm.text:
Die Fenster des Himmels öffnen sich.
Was geschieht?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:de] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: Auf den Wassern
inside.text:
Die Arche schwimmt auf der Tiefe.
Wie lange bleiben die Wasser auf der Erde?

choices.text: [TODO:de] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:de] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:de] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: Die Taube kehrt zurück
dove.text:
Die Wasser beginnen zurückzugehen.
Woher weißt du, dass trockenes Land nahe ist?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: Erde unter deinen Füßen
dry_land.text:
Der Herr befiehlt dir, die Arche zu verlassen.
Was tust du zuerst auf trockenem Land?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: Der Regenbogen
covenant.text:
Ein Regenbogen spannt sich über den Himmel.
„Nie wieder werde ich die Erde überfluten. Dies ist mein Bund mit dir.“
